item.title: It’s Personal: Strategic Communications Takeaways for White-Collar Criminal Representations
item.description: <p><img align=left style="float: left;" src="https://www.odwyerpr.com/site_images/20260210160453_021126August.webp" alt="August" />White-collar criminal matters can quickly become all-encompassing personal crises, requiring close coordination between legal counsel and communications advisors to address both legal and reputational risks. item.title: US Seeks Events Firm for 250th Birthday Bash

item.description: <p><img align=left style="float: left;" src="https://www.odwyerpr.com/site_images/20260210161912_021126DiegoGarcia.webp" alt="Diego Garcia" />Gunster Strategies Worldwide is representing the interests of the Chagossian Government in Exile, which opposes the planned UK transfer of the sovereignty of the Chagos Archipelago, which hosts the joint UK/US military base, to Mauritius.</p>
